raw_translation: Picha ni kusindika ndani na si kupakuliwa au kuhifadhiwa. Hii inajenga picha karatasi sticker tu; haina kuondoa picha backgrounds, kujenga ujumbe-app vifurushi, kuchapisha stickers au kufunga yao katika programu. Matumizi ya kazi za sanaa unayo ruhusa ya kutumia.
source: Images are processed locally and are not uploaded or saved. This creates a sticker sheet image only; it does not remove image backgrounds, create messaging-app packs, publish stickers or install them in an app. Use artwork you have permission to use.
translation: Picha ni kusindika ndani na si kupakuliwa au kuhifadhiwa. Hii inajenga picha karatasi sticker tu; haina kuondoa picha backgrounds, kujenga ujumbe-app vifurushi, kuchapisha stickers au kufunga yao katika programu. Matumizi ya kazi za sanaa unayo ruhusa ya kutumia.

back_sample.translation: Place and circle the small shaped block on the board 10×10. Fill a full row or column of empty and continue playing.

raw_translation: Mahali na kuzunguka maumbo ndogo block juu ya bodi ZXQPH0000QXZ×ZXQPH0001QXZ. Kujaza safu kamili au nguzo ya wazi na kuendelea kucheza.
source: Place and rotate small block shapes on a 10×10 board. Fill a complete row or column to clear it and keep playing.
translation: Mahali na kuzunguka maumbo ndogo block juu ya bodi 10×10. Kujaza safu kamili au nguzo ya wazi na kuendelea kucheza.
